headline: Five-year lease for ten special education buses, and a petition seeking Sullivan Middle School bathroom improvements.
summary: The meeting will cover a five-year bus lease and a student petition about bathrooms at Sullivan Middle School. It also includes two policy changes for 2026-2027 and union contract negotiations discussed in executive session.
items: Executive session: strategy for successor contract negotiations with several Educational Association of Worcester units, and with United Federation of Police Officers, Inc., Local 302 on behalf of Plumbers, Steamfitters and Tradespeople
Recognition of Burncoat High Senior Konstantin Kibe for the 2026 Youth Community Change Maker Award
Public petition (c&p 6-14) from 8th-grade students asking for bathroom improvements and renovations at Sullivan Middle School; recommended referral to Operations and Governance
Student Assessment and Performance Data report (ros 6-14); recommended to approve and file
Boundary realignment presentation (gb 6-72); report already approved and item held for future forums
Proposed changes to the Career Technical Education Admissions Policy for 2026-2027 (gb 6-99); already approved and filed
Proposed changes to the Middle School Pathway Exploration Policy for 2026-2027 (gb 6-100); already approved and filed
Response on how many teachers used or exceeded all their allotted sick time (gb 4-114); recommended to hold for future updates
Update on the City of Worcester Information Technology Department moving out of Worcester Technical High School (gb 6-77); recommended to approve and file
Five-year lease agreement for ten special education buses (gb 6-114); recommended to approve and file
location: Esther Howland Chamber, Worcester City Hall
